trigger: an auditor traces the evidence for the 2026-10-15 exception entry
summary: External-model adjudication (Astra, read-only opinion delivered in this session; no retrievable artefact, hence reporter_ref unresolved): the entry named a future approving review as its 'evidence artefact', claimed '13 rows at acceptance', gave no deferral rationale and no statement of controls not relaxed. No rule requires a per-exception decider sign-off or forbids the owner authoring the record of their own decision. Fixed: the entry now says the owner is 'reported to have accepted', attributes the acceptance to the retrospective quotation in #5955, says no independent review of the entry exists yet, says '13 rows in this change', records the #5859 ground, and states the exception changes no authentication, authorization or audit behaviour. The derivation of facts is the recorder's, from the opinion text.

Supersedes the earlier summary: the first rewrite of the entry (2623e0697) said no contemporaneous ruling existed; that was false. The owner's acceptance is recorded in review edits on #5859, #5872 and #5873 ('Decision recorded (owner, 2026-10-15)') and in the approving review of #5880 ('Owner decision (recorded: accepted)'), and restated in #5955; the entry now cites those, drops the unsupported paraphrase of the ground, names Decision 4 and Grandfathered surface 1, and scopes the waiver to the missing twins without assessing the fragments' own controls. Epistemic status restated to likely: the facts are the recorder's derivation from an opinion with no retrievable artefact.

trigger: a reader or auditor relies on the ADR sentence 'no contemporaneous ruling ... that this entry can cite'
summary: Targeted re-check of 2623e0697 found one false sentence in a normative record (no contemporaneous ruling exists; reviews on #5859, #5872, #5873 and #5880 record the owner decision, verified by the orchestrator with gh), an unsupported paraphrased ground ('rework should not wait'), 'Decisions 1 and 4' where the rulings name Decision 4 and Grandfathered surface 1, and an ambiguous 'changes no authentication, authorization or audit behaviour'. All four corrected in the next commit.

Maintainer decision recorded in this session: the ADR owner states the decision is final and that no independent review of the ADR entry is required. The entry now says so, and no longer lists a missing independent review as an open condition. This closes the provenance finding by owner ruling; it does not add independent evidence, and the entry still says the recorded acceptance is review text edited into the owner's own reviews.
classification_rationale: Owner ruling, not an independent adjudication; the owner is also the change author. Astra (external model) found no rule requiring a per-exception independent review.
